_comment: Every app-visible change serial 14 makes against serial 13 (scripts/validate.py --declared ci/serial14-declared.json --baseline ci/serial3-baseline.json --previous-ref <serial 13> --distros compat/distros.json). Published 2026-11-13: zsh-safe security-updates lines (meshTerm 2.5 review).

changes.reason: Changed (2026-11-13, meshTerm 2.5 review): the systemd-run prefix is no longer a word-split $r (r="systemd-run ..."; {{sudo}}$r apt-get), which zsh does not split: typed into a zsh login shell (meshTerm Manual, or Copy Command pasted by hand) sudo looked for a command named "systemd-run --wait ..." and nothing was upgraded. r is now 1 or empty and each word is its own ${r:+word} expansion, which every POSIX shell and zsh expand to the word or to nothing. Same arguments, same exit status, same needrestart follow-up; measured with a stub sudo in sh, dash, bash and zsh, with and without systemd.
Changed (2026-11-13): the same zsh fix as security-updates.apt (per-word ${r:+word} instead of a word-split $r). Same arguments and exit status.
